title: 第30章 灵步残影的第一次实战
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
两天后的傍晚，安槐在练功房里独自修炼灵步残影。

    教室里所有人都走了，练功房也只剩他一个，他把灯调到最暗，只留一盏角落里的小灯，刚好够照亮脚下的减震垫。

    灵步残影的第三式是三式中最难的，核心要求是在全速移动中同时制造两个残影，让对手无法判断哪个是真身。

    安槐的脚步在黑暗中腾挪，一个虚影留在左侧，他的真身已经闪到了右前方三米外，紧接着第二个虚影在右侧浮现，他的真身从两个虚影的中间穿过。

    速度太快了，练功房里的空气被搅动出一阵细微的风声。

    安槐收功站定，呼吸微微加重了一些。

    第三式的消耗比前两式大了一倍，六重的修为勉强够用，但如果连续使用三次以上，灵气就会出现短暂的空窗期。

    他需要更精准地控制消耗节奏。

    【灵步残影第三式完成度：71%，主要问题在于第二个残影的维持时间太短，容易被高手看穿。建议增加灵气输出的均匀度，把脉冲式改成恒流式。】

    安槐擦了把汗，正要继续练，练功房的门忽然被推开了。

    他下意识地收敛气息，退到阴影里。

    走进来的是钟毅。

    二年级第一，淬体七重。

    钟毅显然没想到里面有人，打开灯的时候愣了一下。

    “安槐？”

    安槐从阴影里站出来。

    “学长。”

    钟毅看了看他身上微微的汗迹和脚下减震垫上的步伐痕迹，目光变得认真。

    “你刚才在练身法？”

    “嗯。”

    钟毅抱着胳膊，打量了他两秒。

    “排位赛之后我一直在琢磨你那天的打法，你的卸力技巧我大概摸透了七八分，但你脚下的步法我始终看不明白。”

    他顿了顿。

    “切磋一下？”

    安槐看着他。

    钟毅这个人，直来直去，没有弯弯绕绕。

    上次被他在教室门口化解之后，排位赛又输了一场，换成一般人可能早就记仇了，但他没有，反而更加认真地研究安槐的打法，然后堂堂正正地来提出切磋。

    这种人挺好的。

    “好。”安槐点头。

    两人站到练功房中央，相距三米。

    钟毅没有废话，直接出手。

    这次他的策略跟排位赛时完全不同，不再是谨慎的试探和防守反击，而是一上来就贴近到近身距离，用七重的修为硬压安槐的活动空间。

    用快制快，用力制巧。

    安槐微微眯眼。

    钟毅学得很快，他发现了安槐的打法依赖空间和距离，所以直接用身体和修为堵死安槐的移动路线。

    安槐后退半步的瞬间，钟毅的拳头已经到了。

    正面硬接？七重的拳劲，六重吃不消。

    安槐的脚尖微微一转。

    灵步残影第一式。

    他的身体在原地留下了一个极淡的虚影，真身已经闪到了钟毅的右侧方。

    钟毅的拳头砸在了虚影上。
content_en:
Two days later in the evening, An Huai was practicing the afterimage of spiritual steps alone in the practice room.

Everyone in the classroom had left, and he was the only one left in the practice room. He turned the lights to the darkest level, leaving only a small lamp in the corner, which was just enough to illuminate the shock-absorbing pads under his feet.

The third form of the Lingbu afterimage is the most difficult of the three. The core requirement is to create two afterimages at the same time while moving at full speed, so that the opponent cannot determine which one is the real body.

An Huai's footsteps moved in the darkness, and a shadow remained on the left. His true body had already flashed three meters away to the right. Then a second shadow appeared on the right, and his true body passed between the two shadows.

The speed was so fast that the air in the practice room was stirred up, making a slight wind sound.

An Huai stopped and stood still, breathing slightly heavier.

The consumption of the third move is twice as much as that of the first two moves. The sixth level of cultivation is barely enough, but if it is used more than three times in a row, there will be a short window of spiritual energy.

He needs to control the consumption rhythm more accurately.

[Completion degree of the third form of the spiritual step afterimage: 71%. The main problem is that the maintenance time of the second afterimage is too short and can easily be seen through by experts.It is recommended to increase the uniformity of the spiritual energy output and change the pulse type to a constant flow type.】

An Huai wiped his sweat and was about to continue practicing when the door of the practice room was suddenly pushed open.

He subconsciously restrained his breath and retreated into the shadows.

It was Zhong Yi who walked in.

Ranked first in the second grade, seventh level of body tempering.

Zhong Yi obviously didn't expect there was anyone inside, and was stunned for a moment when he turned on the light.

"An Huai?"

An Huai stood out from the shadows.

"Senior."

Zhong Yi looked at the slight traces of sweat on his body and the traces of steps on the shock-absorbing pads under his feet, and his eyes became serious.

"Were you practicing your body skills just now?"

"Yeah."

Zhong Yi crossed his arms and looked at him for two seconds.

"After the qualifying match, I have been thinking about your playing style that day. I probably have a good understanding of your offloading skills, but I still can't understand your footwork."

He paused.

"Let's compare notes?"

An Huai looked at him.

Zhong Yi is a person who goes straight, without twists and turns.

After being resolved by him at the door of the classroom last time, he lost another qualifying match. Ordinary people might have held grudges long ago, but he didn't. Instead, he studied An Huai's playing style more seriously, and then came to discuss the matter openly and openly.

This kind of person is quite good.

"Okay." An Huai nodded.

The two stood in the center of the practice room, three meters apart.

Zhong Yi didn't talk nonsense and took action directly.

This time his strategy was completely different from that in the qualifying match. It was no longer cautious probing and defensive counterattacks, but getting close to him from the very beginning, using his seventh-level cultivation to forcefully suppress An Huai's space for movement.

Use speed to make speed and force to make skill.

An Huai narrowed his eyes slightly.

Zhong Yi learned quickly. He discovered that An Huai's style of play relied on space and distance, so he directly used his body and cultivation to block An Huai's movement route.

The moment An Huai took half a step back, Zhong Yi's fist had already arrived.

Hard connection from the front?The seventh level's punch strength is too much for the sixth level.

An Huai turned slightly on his toes.

The first form of Lingbu Yiyi.

His body left a faint shadow on the spot, and his real body had already flashed to Zhong Yi's right side.

Zhong Yi's fist hit the shadow.
title_en: Chapter 30 The first actual battle of Lingbu Yiyi
